claims.statement: Root cause: Carrier partition 2 (east-node) feed consumer stopped advancing at 05:58 and is 47 minutes behind; slots are booked against yesterday's (stale) carrier availability. When EXC-0921 orders are booked against stale data, their availability windows expire before live confirmation arrives (47 min lag > 30 min slot). This blocks pickup state advancement.
Carrier feed consumer for partition 2 explicitly stopped advancing at 05:58 and remains 47 minutes behind; partitions 0 and 1 current.

V18 split reservations route EXC-0921 orders exclusively to partition 2. The partition 2 feed lag (already present) only manifests as stuck orders when v18 routes split reservations to that partition. V18 is the trigger, not the root cause.
One order re-booked after carrier data refreshed received valid slot and confirmed successfully, demonstrating that fixing the stale data condition resolves the hold.
186 orders (9% of overnight allocations) remain stuck with expired slots due to booking against stale carrier partition 2 data; re-booking with fresh data resolves the condition per evidence.

next_action.rationale: Root cause fully established and preconditions satisfied: (1) affected feed identified (partition 2), (2) lag confirmed (47 min at 05:58), (3) fix verified (re-booked order succeeded). Replay held allocations to re-book EXC-0921 orders against current partition 2 data. This matches m8_r_owner preconditions: 'Replaying held allocations is safe only after their pickup slots have been corrected.' Partition 2 consumer resumption corrects the stale data condition; replay applies fresh slots. Authorized as single reversible action. Mission objective satisfied: root cause explained (partition 2 feed lag) and highest-information mitigation approved.
